mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, person_id, channel, purpose, status, source, evidence_ref, captured_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contact_channel_consent (workspace_id, person_id, channel, purpose, status, source, evidence_ref, captured_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{personId}, #{channel}, #{purpose}, #{status}, #{source}, #{evidenceRef}, #{capturedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), status = VALUES(status), source = VALUES(source), evidence_ref = VALUES(evidence_ref), captured_at = VALUES(captured_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO contact_channel_consent_event (workspace_id, consent_id, person_id, channel, purpose, status, source, evidence_ref, created_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{consentId}, #{personId}, #{channel}, #{purpose}, #{status}, #{source}, #{evidenceRef}, #{createdById})
mapper.update: UPDATE contact_channel_consent_event SET created_by_id = NULL WHERE created_by_id = #{userId}
